CollectorCommand.phoboscollector_status_:
phoboscollector status [collector-ID]
phoboscollector controls [collector-ID]
phoboscollector link <collector-ID> <processor-ID>
phoboscollector unlink [endpoint-ID]
phoboscollector start [collector-ID]
phoboscollector pause [collector-ID]
Use full IDs from phoboscollector status or phobosshipbreaker status. Link/unlink beside either endpoint; Start beside the collector.
Unlink accepts a collector or processor ID. Without an ID, commands require one collector. Links survive reload; press Start to resume.
Test-save setup: spawn PhobosResidueCollectorLoose; install over two exterior walls, pocket outward.

Commands.phobos_shipbreaker_commands_pho:
Phobos Shipbreaker commands:
phobosshipbreaker help - show commands
phobosshipbreaker status [fixture-ID] - show fixtures, IDs and processing state
phobosshipbreaker settings - show active settings and the config filename
phobosshipbreaker dependencies - show loaded versions, template checks and recipe registration
phobosshipbreaker start [fixture-ID] - start or resume processing
phobosshipbreaker pause [fixture-ID] - pause, keeping progress
phobosshipbreaker cancel [fixture-ID] - clear queued work; keep panels, no energy refund
phobosshipbreaker feed [fixture-ID] - open the manual feed fallback
phobosshipbreaker products [fixture-ID] - open the product tray
Omit the ID only when there is one fixture on the selected crew member's ship. Stand beside it for controls.
Residue collector controls: phoboscollector help
Test-save setup uses native commands: spawn PhobosShipbreakerLoose / spawn ItmWall1x1Loose. Install normally.

Recipe.PhobosBuildExteriorGrabber.descri: Build an 80 kg, 4 wide x 3 deep exterior loading cradle. Place its rear against a Phobos wall chute; connect conduit power. Load already-detached ordinary walls through Inventory. Static jaws and cutter housing; cutting installed hull is not implemented.

Recipe.PhobosBuildHullChute.description: Build a 40 kg, 4 wide x 1 deep transfer chute. Mount OVER four intact hull walls between a Phobos grabber outside and processor inside. Retain the walls; the chute does not replace them.
Recipe.PhobosBuildHullChute.name: Sealed Hull Chute
Recipe.PhobosBuildResidueCollector.descr: Build a 20 kg, 2 wide x 1 deep collector over two intact exterior walls. Control Panel links a processor through structural flooring. Inventory holds four 13 kg residue packets; collected cargo remains aboard. Separate conduit power required.
Recipe.PhobosBuildResidueCollector.name: Residue Collector
Recipe.PhobosBuildShipbreaker.descriptio: Join two 80 kg assembly sections into a 160 kg, 4 x 4 industrial fixture. Accepts up to four ordinary loose wall panels and recovers parts, scrap and retained residue. Controls: F9 by default while beside the installed fixture, or F3: phobosshipbreaker help.

Recipe.PhobosBuildShipbreakerSection.des: Build one 80 kg, 4 x 4 assembly section. Two sections make a complete powered dismantling fixture. Sections are unpowered construction stock, not working machinery.
